integrity: The proof is symbolic for arbitrary part sizes. A standalone exhaustive checker verifies the literal definition, coefficients, minimum count, and reconstruction through order 9. Bibliographic overlap risk is stated explicitly.
scientific_limitations: Connected complete multipartite graphs only; no claim is made for one-part edgeless graphs or other Roman variants. The scalar minimum is a corollary rather than the novelty-bearing component.
title: Weight enumerator of all independent Roman dominating functions on complete multipartite graphs
